notes.text: /rr hunt walks without stopping again. Since 1.7.3 it stopped every few steps while finishing the edges of a room; it now plans those edges as one walk and turns on each of them without a halt. anthell01 is searched in about 6 minutes.

/rr hunt no longer leaves thin strips at the edges of the rooms it crosses, only to walk all the way back for them at the end. A full search is about a quarter shorter on maps without a built-in route — anthell01 goes from about 10 to 8 minutes.
/rr hunt no longer walks into a warp portal it already knew about and ends up on the next map. On cmd_fild03 it used to leave at about a quarter of the search, on ayo_dun02 at about 60 %.
A long MVP Status Board is now read to the end. Past about 250 entries, the MVPs listed last (Tao Gunka among them) were skipped, so their timers were never corrected from it.
Starting /rr hunt again on the same map picks up where the last hunt stopped instead of walking the searched ground again. Once a map has been fully searched, the next hunt starts fresh.
/rr hunt <name or id> during a hunt switches it to that mob without starting over: /rr hunt, then /rr hunt ghostring.
Every reachable part of a map can now get a ready-made hunting route. pay_fild04 ships with one: about a quarter less walking to search the whole map.
A second Garm Baby on xmas_dun02 means Stormy Knight is up: the radar says so, and /rr hunt stops on it like on a tomb.
/rr hunt can put the Boarding Halter on before it sets off. Off by default; turn it on in the Options tab.
notes.details: Only a character on foot with the Halter in its Inventory is mounted. It is never taken off at the end of a hunt; remember that skills are locked while mounted.

notes.text: Killing one of Stormy Knight's Garm Babies no longer starts a respawn timer on the natural Garm Baby of xmas_dun02.
Coming back to xmas_dun02 no longer announces Stormy Knight as up when its death is already on record.
A mob that walks into view is now noticed right away, not only one that appears in place.
